values: Estimated v3 experiment package for RC-PPO/RA retrofit
RA = reach-avoid baseline; RC-PPO = minimum-cost reach-avoid baseline; HD-MCRA = hierarchical RC-PPO with data-driven conservative margins
Assumed common reference budget within each scenario; main/ablation use z0/z_ref = 1.00. Sweep uses {0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.96, 1.00, 1.05, 1.12, 1.20}. Absolute z_ref remains TBD.
SR, CR, Average Cost, BVR, Minimum Clearance
Smallest z0/z_ref such that SR >= 60%, CR <= 20%, and BVR <= 15% on the evaluation set.
Hsu et al. RSS 2021; So et al. NeurIPS 2024; Achiam et al. ICML 2017; Tessler et al. ICLR 2019; Hu et al. RA-L 2021; Weerakoon et al. ICRA 2024

All values are hypothetical. 2026-10-23 reconciliation preserves main scene values; repeated baseline rows/reference-budget points are derived from them. Single-margin ablations remain separate assumptions with non-additive effects. See CCDC/submission/1023数据一致性核查.md.

Draft convention: equal scene means; success excludes physical collision but budget compliance is separate; cost and footprint clearance average all trials through goal/collision/timeout; budget violation does not terminate evaluation.
Same assumed RA rollouts re-scored under different budget thresholds: SR/CR/cost fixed, only BVR changes.
Figure horizontal ranges are manually specified hypothetical ranges, not SD/SE or confidence intervals; original trial counts and cost units remain unverified.
